notes: Splits are declared before any cell is scored. A split listed under queued names a direction only and must never be scored until it is moved here with source columns, an exact cell rule and a leakage note.
Cell cut points are computed from conditioning inputs alone, never from outcomes. Median splits use medians over the conditioning population, not over wins.
Every scored cell is recorded with weak-signals record under family <signal>__<split>, including unresolved ones. Never drop a cell for containing zero.
Version is bumped whenever a split is added or a rule changes; scored cells cite the version they were scored under.
queued: rest and travel (short week, bye, long trip)

ol_rush_continuity.cell_rule: High-continuity game: all four unit values (both teams offensive-line continuity and both teams pass-rush continuity) sit above their respective 2020-2025 team-season medians. Every other game is low-continuity. Medians are taken over the continuity table only, never over outcomes.
ol_rush_continuity.leakage_note: Continuity for season S uses only regular seasons before S and the season-S week-1 roster, both fixed before the season's first kickoff. Assumption documented: week-1 roster status is treated as known before any week 1-4 kickoff. Snap seasons before 2013 do not exist locally, so seasons before 2020 cannot be scored under this split.
ol_rush_continuity.unit: offensive-line continuity is the share of the team's prior-season regular-season offensive-line snaps taken by players on its week-1 roster; pass-rush continuity is the same share over prior-season defensive snaps by primary pass-rush positions. Scored for weeks 1-4 only, where the protection tilt's pressure window can reach into the prior season.

week_in_season.leakage_note: Game week is known before kickoff.
week_in_season.status: already scored under family pbp08_protection_mismatch_window_split before this library existed; recorded here as the library's first entry, not as a predeclared one. Future signals use the three cells as stated.

spread_band.cell_rule: Short: absolute Tuesday-opener home spread of 7.0 or less. Long: 7.5 or more. Lines move in half-point steps so the cut is gapless; whole-number 7.0 falls short. Cut taken from the audit spread-bucket read, not fit in this session.
spread_band.leakage_note: The Tuesday opener is the decision-time line the pool locks and grades against; conditioning on it adds no post-decision information.
